info.title: CF Meet communications private Communications integration
info.description: Private backend interfaces for Sections 4–7. Never routed by public ingress or advertised by public Swagger. The owner retains canonical data. Scope, permissions and identities come from signed service authentication; request bodies cannot impersonate principals. 1.7.0: short CF Meet IDs (CF- plus 6 characters). 1.8.0 (S2): account-erasure and account-export for the account authority (communications-account.apply): a deleted account's Hub data is erased; the account's data download reads it back. 1.10.0 (ADR 0068, admin bridge): operator attribution (X-CF-Operator, X-CF-Approver, X-CF-Approval-Ref, X-CF-Intent-Digest) accepted only from cfmeet.admin-bridge and refused on every route from any other caller; the admin bridge's operator reads GET /internal/v1/communications/operator/profiles/{cfMeetId}, /reports, /holds, /audit and /metrics, each requiring communications.administer and X-CF-Operator.

post.description: Dispatch Account-verified consumer operations. Private signed service traffic only; the delegated tenant, application and environment must match the verified Platform Access authority. Permission communications-user.forward is granted only by the receiving service trust policy. Replayed JWT hops are refused by the Hub; events and commands additionally deduplicate their durable identities. Failures never grant communications.

post.summary: Check a typed live personal authorization decision
post.description: Check a typed live personal authorization decision. Private signed service traffic only; the delegated tenant, application and environment must match the verified Platform Access authority. Permission communications-policy.check is granted only by the receiving service trust policy. Replayed JWT hops are refused by the Hub; events and commands additionally deduplicate their durable identities. Failures never grant communications. MESSAGE_NOTIFICATION and GROUP_NOTIFICATION are Messaging-only delayed push decisions. They enforce active accounts, live blocks and recipient contact notification preferences. MENTIONS suppresses ordinary opaque notifications because the server cannot infer mentions from E2EE content. Group membership remains authoritative in Messaging; absence of a personal connection alone does not exclude an admitted group member.

post.summary: Resolve a CF Meet ID for an organization invitation (Meeting Service only)
post.description: Translates a CF Meet ID into the owning account reference for an organization invitation the Meeting Service creates on the inviter's behalf. Callable by cfmeet.meeting-service only (permission communications-user.forward). The inviter's Hub profile is ensured from `account` exactly like dispatch, and the consumer-discovery rules apply to the inviter: discoverable public id, visible profile, no block in either direction, active account, the discovery.resolve attempt budget (429). Every id the inviter may not discover answers the same 404 as an unknown id. The account reference is never relayed to clients. 1.5.0.

200.description: The account that owns the CF Meet ID.

post.summary: Name the caller's connected contacts (Meeting Service only)
post.description: Display names of the caller's CONNECTED, unblocked Communications Hub contacts among `principalIds` (at most 256), for the CF Meet client's names lookup (POST /api/v2/messaging/principals/names) of personal calls and conversations. Callable by cfmeet.meeting-service only (permission communications-user.forward). The caller's Hub profile is ensured from `account` exactly like dispatch. Each named contact carries the name the Hub contact list shows (`displayName`) and the caller's private `alias` when set. A pending, revoked or blocked (either direction) relationship, the caller itself and unknown ids are left out without an error, so the answer never reveals more than the caller's own contact list. Hub responses still never carry principal ids. 1.6.0.

200.description: The caller's connected contacts among the asked principals.

post.summary: List the accounts that turned a notification category off
post.description: List the accounts that turned a notification category off (Blueprint Section 11). Private signed service traffic only; the delegated tenant, application and environment must match the verified Platform Access authority. Permission communications-preferences.read is granted only by the receiving service trust policy and only the Meeting Service may call it. MEETINGS is the meetingInvitations preference (meeting invitation, change and reminder emails). Accounts without a Communications profile or without a stored preference are not listed (the default is enabled). Returns account references only, never preference values, profile data or principals. At most 100 account references per request.

Account lifecycle event from the account authority. STATUS_CHANGED / SESSION_REVOKED: when credentials end (SESSION_REVOKED, or a SUSPENDED / DEACTIVATED state) the revocation reaches Calling and Messaging through the durable outbox (`communications.account.changed` with principalId and credentialsNotBefore), for a Hub profile or, since 1.3.0, for an account without one (the principal is read from Account; fanOut PRINCIPAL). ACCOUNT_SESSION_ENDED (1.3.0): one Account session ended; the Hub devices that session linked are revoked at their owners and become REVOKED (ACCOUNT_SESSION_ENDED); the account epoch and version are unchanged. An owner failure answers 503 and the producer retries the same event. Apply monotonic Account authority events. Private signed service traffic only; the delegated tenant, application and environment must match the verified Platform Access authority. Permission communications-account.apply is granted only by the receiving service trust policy. Replayed JWT hops are refused by the Hub; events and commands additionally deduplicate their durable identities. Failures never grant communications.

post.summary: Project canonical Calling block rules before confirmation
post.description: 1.9.0: ruleId and projectionGeneration enable synchronous forwarding to Messaging. Calling retains authority; per-rule versions preserve release tombstones, including application-wide rules. A failed receiver ACK returns 503 after the durable outbox write; retry the same event. The older pair-only bridge payload remains deprecated and is never used for a policy decision.

post.summary: Erase a deleted account's Hub data
post.description: S2: in one transaction the account's CF Meet IDs (current and retired), contacts, contact lists, saved messages, conversation preferences, clear-for-me marks, timeline entries and change feed are deleted; its open invites are revoked, pending contact requests cancelled and connections ended (REVOKED; BLOCKED stays). The profile row stays as the anchor of other people's records with a neutral display name, no avatar, DEACTIVATED and credentials revoked (fanned out to Calling and Messaging). Audited ACCOUNT_ERASED with counts only. Idempotent; an account without a Hub profile answers profile false. Private signed service traffic only; the delegated tenant, application and environment must match the verified Platform Access authority. Permission communications-account.apply is granted only by the receiving service trust policy (Meeting Service).

S2: the account's own Hub data for its data download: profile, CF Meet IDs, privacy and notification settings, contacts, contact lists, saved messages, conversation preferences, devices and contact requests (at most 1000 per list). Private signed service traffic only; the delegated tenant, application and environment must match the verified Platform Access authority. Permission communications-account.apply is granted only by the receiving service trust policy (Meeting Service).

cfServiceAuth.name: X-CF-Service-Authorization
cfServiceAuth.description: Bearer EdDSA service JWT from cf-service-auth; audience, runtime, request IDs, scope, expiration and receiver-granted permission are verified.

erased.description: Rows removed or changed per kind (counts only).

accountSessionRef.description: ACCOUNT_SESSION_ENDED only (required there, refused on every other kind): the Account session that ended. Opaque, domain-separated reference of one Account session (SHA-256 of 'cfmeet-account-session:v1|environment|session', lowercase hex). Receivers can match it, never reverse it.

AccountEvent.description: Account lifecycle event from the account authority. STATUS_CHANGED / SESSION_REVOKED: when credentials end (SESSION_REVOKED, or a SUSPENDED / DEACTIVATED state) the revocation reaches Calling and Messaging through the durable outbox (`communications.account.changed` with principalId and credentialsNotBefore), for a Hub profile or, since 1.3.0, for an account without one (the principal is read from Account; fanOut PRINCIPAL). ACCOUNT_SESSION_ENDED (1.3.0): one Account session ended; the Hub devices that session linked are revoked at their owners and become REVOKED (ACCOUNT_SESSION_ENDED); the account epoch and version are unchanged. An owner failure answers 503 and the producer retries the same event.

profile.description: null: the account never opened the Hub.

ruleId.description: Canonical Calling rule identity for synchronous Messaging projection.

applicationBlock.description: Application-wide principal refusal; Calling only and requires ruleId.

projectionGeneration.description: Must match the prepared send-policy generation when ruleId is supplied.

alias.description: The caller's private alias for the contact, when set.

DispatchResult.description: The consumer response for the dispatched public operation; a strictly bounded versioned JSON object. See the public Communications contract for each operation.

fanOut.description: Account events (1.3.0): how a credential revocation was fanned out (PRINCIPAL: account without a Hub profile).

devicesRevoked.description: ACCOUNT_SESSION_ENDED (1.3.0): devices revoked because the session ended.

self.description: Present (true) when the CF Meet ID is the inviter's own.

purpose.description: Optional for compatibility. Calling may request only DIRECT_CALL; Messaging only DIRECT_CONVERSATION (default) or GROUP_INVITATION. Other caller/purpose pairs are forbidden.

accountSessionRef.description: Sent by Account only on device link and device revoke (1.3.0): the Account session making the request. A link records it; a revoke of a bound device then returns the bound reference for Account to end that session (Account consumes it; it is never shown to clients). Opaque, domain-separated reference of one Account session (SHA-256 of 'cfmeet-account-session:v1|environment|session', lowercase hex). Receivers can match it, never reverse it.
